summary: Peers compare the claims they retain by claim-range digest during sync

replay.detail: No replay. The summary reads the existing claim range digests (64 top ranges) once per exchange export and receipt.

schema.detail: No storage change. The comparison times live in memory with the other per-peer sync measurements.

rules.detail: Each exchange carries a claim-range summary (protocol version 1: count and digest of every retained claim, omitted while the range index folds). A member records when it last compared its claims with each peer's and since when they differ (claims_compared_at_unix_ms, claims_differ_since_unix_ms in the peer's sync status). The difference gates nothing: no divergence, first-sync, repair or admission change.

compatibility.detail: Adds an optional claim_ranges field to the replication exchange and two optional fields to a peer's sync status. Older peers ignore the field and send none, so they are compared by envelopes alone; members upgrade in any order.

recovery.detail: Swapping back to an earlier binary is supported; it drops the field and the comparison.
